target_hardware_contract.source: existing frozen OCP v0.7.0 Grade2 HBF configuration
target_hardware_contract.scope: channel count and bandwidth only; it supplies no numerical temperature-to-RBER, UBER, or retry curve

activation_energy_ev.source: existing project HeatWatch older-NAND transfer assumption
activation_energy_ev.limitation: not measured on the target HBF and not a target-device calibration

recoverable_read_probability_at_85c_cand.limitation: candidate strengths, not confidence bounds or measured HBF RBER

expected_extra_attempts_per_recoverable_.limitation: not a measured ECC decoder or retry distribution

temperature_domain_k.source: existing coupled thermal solver validity guard
temperature_domain_k.limitation: a solver domain guard, not evidence that the retry equation is calibrated across the domain

uber.limitation: the proxy cannot support UBER, UECC, or data-loss claims
